_format: Append-only ledger of proposed data corrections. One entry per proposal. `status` is the human decision: open = undecided, accepted = apply it, rejected = never propose again.
_intent: A single visible place for corrections proposed by any source — a detector script, Gemini, an audit flag, or an AI assistant reading the data — so they are reviewable and durable instead of buried in a chat log. Detectors must never edit curation files directly; they append here and wait for a decision.
_workflow: 1. A detector or agent appends proposals with status=open. 2. Josh reviews and sets accepted/rejected. 3. An apply tool copies accepted proposals into the real curation file (elision_mapping.json, proper_nouns.json, extra_english.json, lemma_overrides.json...). 4. rejected entries stay here forever as a veto, so the same wrong proposal is never re-raised.
_fields: id (stable, kind:word), kind, word, current, proposed, operation (structured mutation: add_drop | add_keep | remove_drop | remove_keep | add_occurrence_override | add_override | set_gloss | merge_elision | replace_elision), occurrence_action + occurrence_ids (+ normalization_target when applicable), reason, evidence (the lyric line), source, confidence, status, created, artist
_kinds: echo_reduplication | lemma | elision | proper_noun | english | cognate | noise | gloss
